intro.text: An alcoholic drink served in taverns across western Roshar, popular in the depths of winter.

description.text: The Unkalaki use it to settle arguments: the two compete to drink the most while still able to sing, and usually both get too drunk to recall the quarrel.
Even the winehouses of Urithiru serve it.

items.text: Kaladin told his bridgemen, as he resolved to help them escape, that within a few weeks they'd all be sharing mudbeer in a tavern.
The evening Rock told Kaladin he would return home to the Horneater Peaks, Rock's family drank mudbeer with him at Jez's Duty.
